records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our revenue increased by $42.0 million, or 28.3%, to $190.5 million for the three months ended June 28, 2024, from $148.5 million for the three months ended June 30, 2023, and our revenue increased by $30.8 million, or 6.2%, to $528.9 million for the nine months ended June 28, 2024, from $498.0 million for the nine months ended June 30, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •continued growth in the demand for high-performance analog, digital and optical semiconductors in our three primary markets;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, cash used in operating assets and liabilities was $36.1 million for the nine months ended June 28, 2024, primarily driven by an increase in accounts receivables of $17.9 million, an increase in inventories of $25.1 million, a decrease of $6.1 million in accrued and other liabilities, partially offset by an increase of $14.7 million in accounts payable.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 53.2% and 58.0% for the three months ended June 28, 2024 and June 30, 2023, respectively, and 53.7% and 60.1% for the nine months ended June 28, 2024 and June 30, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, cash used in operating assets and liabilities was $39.9 million for the nine months ended June 30, 2023, primarily driven by an increase in inventories of $12.2 million and a decrease of $16.6 million in accrued and other liabilities.
